Companies

108. An employee may represent the company at a fast-track or multi-track interim or final
hearing, provided the employee has been authorised by the company to appear and the
court gives permission (CPR 39.6).

109. This does not apply to small claims. Any officer or employee may represent the company on
a small claim (CPR Part 27 PD 3.2(4)).
Official Receivers

110. Rule 7.52 of the Insolvency Rules 1986 gives Official Receivers a right of audience in both
the High Court and a county court.
